main_text.p: נְדוּדִין Ch. Salebrae, Viae asperae, Jesa.40.4. Item Turmae, Copiae, Exercitus, Psal.31.21.
נַדָּה Ch. Hoedus. Plur. נַדַּיִין Hoedi, Deut.14.4.& נַדַּיִן Ezech.27.41. Deuter.32.14. in T. Hierosol. ubi Jon. נַדָּאִין: Syr. ܢܦܪܘܫ ܥܠܝ ܕܝܢ ܥܢܝܐ Qui separat oves ab hoedis, Matth.25.32.33.

נְדַל Syr. Contexere, Contorquere, Intorquere, ܟܕܝܪ Contexuerunt coronam, Joh.19.2. Pahel נְדַל Ch. Idem: כְּתִבָא דְמִגְדְּלָא Sicut catena quae contorta est, Eccles. 4. 12. Alii legunt מִגְדָּלָא. Ithpah. אִתְגְּדַל Ch. Magnum, magnificum esse vel fieri, Magnificari, Psalm.104.1. Item Implicari, Contorqueri.
גְּדִילָא Ch. Funis, filum, funiculus contortus seu conduplicatus, Cincinnus. Plur. גְּדִילָן Funes, institae, fasciae. constr. גְּדִילַת.
גְּדִילוּ Ch. Perplexitas, Intricatio, Implicatio, Contortuplicatio, 1.Reg.7.17. Exod.28.22.
Syr. Implicationes, Intorsiones, Intorti crines, 1.Pet.3.3. 1.ad Timoth.2.9.
מוּגְדָּלָא, מַגְדָּלָא, מִגְדָּל Ch. & Syr. Turris. Plur. מִגְדָּלִין.
גַּרְנַפָּא Ch. Clausura, Taenia, Plur. גַּרְנַפִּין, גַּרְנַפָּא.
נַדָּע Ch. Abscindere, abradere, 2.Sam.10.4. Ithpehal אִתְגַּדַּע Abscindi, Succidi, Num.33.4. in Jon.
נַדָּף Pahel Ch. & Syr. Blasphemavit, Covitiis, Contumeliis

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; the vocalisation and Syriac forms are approximate in places. Faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored. The Syriac pointed words in lines 3 and 6 are uncertain.
